$comment: WHICH HA CHARTS THE MULTI-NODE LANE ASSERTS, AND WHICH IT DOES NOT (081M48Z020C087G0R001E6M83V).
An 'HA chart' is DERIVED, not listed by hand: every Application the single-node readiness
auditor's extractReplicaClaims() reports with replicas > 1 at nodeCount = 1, UNION every
entry of k8s/single-node-budget.json `acknowledgedFalseRedundancy`. The union is needed
because each side misses something the other has: the extractor does not read a CNPG
Cluster's `instances` (postgres-shared is only in the ledger), and the ledger is hand-kept.
src/Core.TypeScript/cluster/multinode-ha-lane-coverage.test.ts fails when an HA chart is in
none of the three lists below, when a `covered` entry names a phase the lane does not run,
or when a `staleLedgerEntries` entry stops being stale. Moving an app from notCovered to
covered is the work this file tracks; it is done by adding its phase to
k3s-multinode-ha-agents.nix, never by editing this file alone.

full-ai-cluster/postgres-shared.phase: postgres failed over; pre-crash row present, new write committed
full-ai-cluster/postgres-shared.what: metal rung (instances 3, enablePDB, preferred anti-affinity) derived from cluster.yaml: 3 instances on 3 distinct nodes, 2 streaming replicas, PDB present; the agent holding the primary is hard-killed; CNPG fails over, the pre-crash row is read and a new write commits. Barman plugin and 20Gi size removed (named in the lane).

full-ai-cluster/longhorn.phase: longhorn data intact on agent2, volume degraded
full-ai-cluster/longhorn.what: not an acknowledgedFalseRedundancy entry but the storage every HA chart stands on: prod chart values unmodified, a disk registered on each of 3 nodes (2 of them agents), a zeta-block-replicated-derived class at numberOfReplicas 3 places 3 replicas on 3 distinct nodes, and the data survives hard-killing an agent that held one.

notCovered.full-ai-cluster/cockroachdb: 3 Raft members, chart soft anti-affinity. Not deployed in the lane: three CockroachDB pods are the heaviest HA workload in the tree and the lane has not yet measured headroom for them beside postgres-shared on 3 x ~3 GiB guests. Next candidate.
notCovered.full-ai-cluster/nats: JetStream config.cluster.replicas 3, no anti-affinity. Not deployed in the lane yet; light enough to be the next addition after cockroachdb's headroom is measured.
notCovered.full-ai-cluster/redis: replica.replicas 2, async replication (no quorum). Not deployed in the lane; its node-loss behaviour has no failover claim to assert without Sentinel, which this tree does not enable.
notCovered.full-ai-cluster/kubevirt: virt-operator replicas 2 from the vendored upstream manifest. Not deployed: KubeVirt needs nested virtualisation inside a QEMU guest on a hosted runner, which the lane does not provide.
notCovered.full-ai-cluster/platform: examples/gmod-server.yaml replicas 2, a sample workload, not on the critical path. Not deployed.

staleLedgerEntries.full-ai-cluster/vault: acknowledgedFalseRedundancy names it, but no k8s/applications/vault directory exists (openbao is the secrets store and serves replicas: 1). The acknowledgement is dead; removing it from single-node-budget.json is the fix, and this entry then goes red so it is removed here too.
